claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_attached_creature_spends_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The escape mechanic — 'A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC' — requires a trigger that fires when the attached (restrained) creature spends an Action. The existing on_caster_spends_action trigger only models the caster spending an action, not the target. This is a new variant of OngoingTrigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: once_per_creature_per_turn predicate on OngoingTrigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save fires only 'the first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there' — a deduplication guard preventing double-trigger if both on_creature_enters_area and on_attached_turn_start fire in the same turn. No existing OngoingPredicate variant covers this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_lightly_obscured
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell makes the area Lightly Obscured (Lightly Obscured = disadvantage on Perception checks to see into/through), which has no EffectAtom. This is distinct from Heavily Obscured and from darkvision — it is an area property, not a creature sense. It has mechanical consequences (Perception disadvantage) that are not captured by any existing atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the area within them is Lightly Obscured
